text: Utilz's first cut in this shape fires every leg on its candidate's run, and its RELEASE seal names each one; the core's object step attaches Menuz.app.zip before the formula step runs; and the core's formula step, `bin/devbin formula publish --pull` under release.formula, moves homebrew-utilz to the new tag and pulls this machine's clone of it, rendering the formula from packaging/homebrew/utilz.rb through the core's @@INSTALL@@ alone. tools/formula is retired.
